items.title: Palestine weekly: West Bank under siege as Israelis go to the polls
items.description: Israel sealed the West Bank, emptied parts of Hebron and tightened the squeeze on Gaza as its election campaign closed.

items.title: Local ceasefire brokered by Melania Trump starts in southern Ukraine
items.description: A localized ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia took effect early Tuesday ahead of a humanitarian mission brokered by U.S. first lady Melania Trump, as missile attacks resumed in Kyiv.

items.title: Truce begins in wartorn Ukraine city after it was announced by Melania Trump
items.description: The ceasefire is meant to allow aid deliveries and the evacuation of civilians.

items.title: West Bank: In Hebron, behind Israeli army barricades, a bitter sense of 'collective punishment'
items.description: After an attack that killed two Israeli soldiers on October 23, the Israeli army sealed off several neighborhoods in the occupied West Bank city and forcibly displaced more than 2,000 Palestinians.

items.title: Cease-Fire Takes Effect Near Oleshky As Russian Strikes Hit Kyiv
items.description: Russian air attacks struck Kyiv late on October 26, hitting a university dormitory and other civilian sites, leaving at least one dead, as President Volodymyr Zelenskyy called on Ukraine's partners to provide the "proper tools" for the country to defend itself.

items.title: UN cites 'ethnic cleansing' concerns around Israel's Palestinian displacement operation in Hebron
items.description: The United Nations on Monday raised "ethnic cleansing" concerns following Israel's operation to displace by force more than 3,000 Palestinians from their homes in Hebron in the West Bank after two Palestinian gunmen killed two Israeli soldiers at a checkpoint near the city on Friday. items.title: Why Ukraine may be involved in Mali's conflict
items.description: Allegations that Ukrainian specialists are supporting Tuareg rebels in Mali highlight Kyiv's effort to challenge Russian influence far beyond the battlefield in Europe.

items.title: ‘Still Just a Child’: The Russian Teenagers Fighting and Dying in Ukraine
items.description: A growing number of Russian soldiers who were still schoolchildren when the full-scale invasion of Ukraine began are being killed in the war.

items.title: Cremlino, 'tregua a Oleshky può essere precedente per altre iniziative'
items.description: 'Soprattutto con l'intervento dei negoziatori americani e di Melania Trump'

items.title: Russia Says Ukraine Peace Talks Won’t Slow War, Open to Local Truces
items.description: Russia says upcoming US-brokered peace talks will not slow its war against Ukraine but signals openness to local humanitarian truces. The Kremlin’s stance comes as a ceasefire is planned for Russian-occupied Oleshky to allow aid deliveries and civilian evacuations.

items.title: Police and protesters clash in Paris as demonstrations break out across Europe
items.description: Demonstrations rocked many European cities Saturday, from Milan to Madrid. The protests encompass a broad range of issues, from education to housing.

items.title: Women ‘first to suffer’ under siege, first to step up as frontline responders in Sudan
items.description: When Tahani Al-Numeiri heard the first explosions in Khartoum, her hometown, war seemed so remote that she assumed they were celebrations from a nearby wedding. It was the morning of 15 April 2023, and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces had just turned their guns on the army.
